title: Photonic Chirality for Braiding and Readout of Non-Abelian Anyons
summary: We propose a cavity-based scheme that uses photonic chirality to control braiding and read out non-Abelian anyons in a fractional quantum Hall platform. Counter-propagating cavity modes interfere with a classical reference tone to create a rotating pinning landscape whose direction is set by photon circulation, so that opposite photonic branches drive opposite anyon loops. This realizes a branch-conditioned braid operation and maps the resulting braid response onto cavity intermode coherence.
